ns2:section.sectionText: In this course, we will cover a variety of methods that seismologists use to probe the structure and dynamics of the interior of Earth and other planetary bodies. A wide range of topics will be explored including the fundamentals of seismic wave propagation, seismic imaging, and earthquake source inversion. The course will consist of lectures and computer-based assignments aimed at giving practical experience with seismic analysis methods used in modern research. 4 credit hours.
